[7] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.331, sim=0.5991)
[CR CR1498r1 for 38.331] Reason for change: New features specified in the Work Item on support of Industrial Internet of Things (NR_IIOT) and the Work Item on Physical layer enhancements for NR ultra-reliable and low latency communication (NR_L1enh_URLLC). Summary of change: This CR introduces new features specified in NR_IIOT WI and new features related to UL configured grant and UL Intra-UE prioritization in NR_L1enh_URLLC WI. The features introduced under NR_L1enh_URLLC WI are specifically indicated. If not indicated, the features are introduced under NR_IIOT WI. Add the new information element ReferenceTimeInfo and its usage in SIB9 and DLInformationTransfer Add support of multiple DL SPS and UL CG in one BWP and shorter periodicity for DL SPS and UL CG. UL CG is introduced in NR_L1enh

[8] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.331, sim=0.586)
[CR CR4617r1 for 38.331] Reason for change: The CR is to address the issues mentioned by RILs: E079, E106, E114, S651 and N082. Summary of change: In text procedure, to refer to field name ncr-FwdConfig, not IE name NCR-FwdConfig; Add extension markers to NCR-AperiodicFwdTimeResource-r18, NCR-PeriodicFwdResource-r18 and NCR-SemiPersistentFwdResource-r18; Change “Need N” to “setupRelease {}, Need M” for aperiodicFwdConfig-r18 in NCR-FwdConfig-r18. Add missing RAN1 spec references; Remove redundant field descriptions according to RAN2#125 agreements. Consequences if not approved: Wrong reference and need code are used in RRC spec for NCR.

[9] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.331, sim=0.5858)
[CR CR4446r2 for 38.331] Reason for change: Introduction of the rel-18 work item Enhancement on NR QoE management and optimizations for diverse services Summary of change: Support for application layer measurements in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE added. Support for application layer measurements in NR-DC added. Consequences if not approved: The rel-18 work item Enhancement on NR QoE management and optimizations for diverse services will not work.

[10] (ran2_cr_chunks 36.331, sim=0.5745)
[CR CR3628r2 for 36.331] Reason for change: Updating the CGI reporting timer T321 for inter-RAT CGI reporting towards NR Summary of change: Currently there is an FFS on the CGI reporting timer T321 for inter-RAT CGI reporting towards NR. Based on the LS from RAN4 (R4-1811851) on the values that should be used for CGI reporting timer T321 in different scenarios, Section 5.5.2.3 should be updated. Also corrections needed to sections 5.5.4.1 and 7.3.1 regarding when the UE realizes that there is no SIB1 for the concerned NR cell. Note: This CR has been agreed in principle in RAN2#103bis. Impact analysis: Inter-RAT CGI reporting towards NR will fail as the velues for the reporting timer T321 is not specified. Consequences if not approved: The specification does not correctly reflect the ANR fu
